acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer and selection of top 20 ions with dynamic exclusion followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap with rapid scan rate.
alkylation_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
alkylation_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
cleavage_agent: The bound proteins were eluted with 2x SDS sample buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH6.8, 4% SDS, 12% glycerol, 2% β-mercaptoethanol, 0.008% bromophenol), separated with the bait peptides on SDS-PAGE, and subjected to trypsin digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
fractionation_method: Proteins from SILAC pull-down experiments were separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to in-gel tryptic digest.
fragmentation_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer and selection of top 20 ions with dynamic exclusion followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap with rapid scan rate.
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Sigma, F0392) and stable isotope labeled lysine and arginine (light: 12 C and 14 N; heavy: 13 C and 15 N; 50 mg each for 500 mL medium).
mass_analyzer: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer and selection of top 20 ions with dynamic exclusion followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap with rapid scan rate.
reduction_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
reduction_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were separated by high pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC) using an Dionex Ultimate 3000 LC-system (Thermo Scientific) and analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
